HERO.TITLE: A century of music and tradition
HERO.SUBTITLE: The town band of Casali del Manco: passion, community and band culture growing year after year.

ASSOCIAZIONE.TITLE: Our association
ASSOCIAZIONE.TEXT: We are a non-profit association promoting band music across the local area through concerts, education and community initiatives. We preserve our roots while creating opportunities for people of different generations to meet through music.

SEDE.TITLE: Headquarters
SEDE.TEXT: Our headquarters are at 31 Via Traversa Campanile, in Pedace, Casali del Manco (CS). This is where we rehearse, run the music school and plan the association's activities. It is where repertoires, friendships and new projects take shape.

STORIA.TITLE: Our history
STORIA.TEXT: Pedace's band tradition is documented as far back as 1861. After many new beginnings, the historic Pedace band adopted the name “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band in 2019, two years after the new municipality was created from five communities. Today we continue that story through concerts, education and new projects.

BANDA.TITLE: The band
BANDA.TEXT: Our ensemble combines the experience of long-standing members with the energy of new generations. Its repertoire includes marches, original wind-band music, transcriptions, film scores and contemporary arrangements. The band is conducted by Franco Guglielmelli, assisted by Pietro Rizzo.

SCUOLA.TITLE: The music school
SCUOLA.TEXT: We offer a gradual programme combining music theory, score reading and instrumental practice, with individual lessons and ensemble sessions. Courses are taught by Pietro Rizzo, Gianmarco Scrivano, Daniela D'Ambrosio and Mario Zicarelli.

DIRETTIVO.TITLE: The board of directors
DIRETTIVO.TEXT: The board coordinates the association's activities, events and projects, making decisions on behalf of all its members. Aurelio Marotta is the association's president.

EVENT_CTA.TITLE: Planning an event, a festival or a commissioned concert?
EVENT_CTA.DESC: We can bring the band to patron saint festivals, anniversaries and commissioned concerts: tell us your idea and let's make it happen together.

ABOUT.HEADER_DESC: The “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band promotes musical culture and participation. Every rehearsal and concert helps strengthen the community and create new connections.
ABOUT.SEC_STORIA_TEXT: The “Città di Casali del Manco” town band was born from the will to preserve and grow a local tradition. Over time it has become a cultural landmark: a place where music unites generations, creates friendships and builds community.
ABOUT.SEC_OGGI_TEXT: Today the band is a lively and growing group: rehearsals, study and carefully curated repertoires. We perform band music, modern arrangements, soundtracks and classics, always seeking a balance between quality and participation.
ABOUT.SEC_SCUOLA_TEXT: The music school is our investment in the future: a path to introduce children, teenagers and adults to studying an instrument, step by step and with clear goals. This is where passion — and the band's continuity — begins.
ABOUT.FINAL_TITLE: Want to play with us or join the school?
ABOUT.FINAL_DESC: Write to us: we'll reply with information about rehearsals, enrolment and activities.

ABOUT_TODAY.HEADER_TITLE: A living group, a shared sound
ABOUT_TODAY.HEADER_DESC: The “Città di Casali del Manco” town band is an active community bringing together musicians of different generations. Weekly rehearsals, concerts, processions: a steady commitment to bring music and tradition to the area.
ABOUT_TODAY.HERO_CAPTION: The full band during a recent concert
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_ORGANICO_TEXT: The band currently has around 30–40 active musicians across woodwind, brass and percussion. The lineup varies with each engagement, from smaller groups for processions and ceremonies to the full ensemble for open-air concerts and special events.
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_REPERTORIO_TEXT: The repertoire ranges from Italian band traditions — marches, opera transcriptions and concert works — to film scores, pop arrangements and contemporary compositions. New music is introduced every year to encourage curiosity and musical growth.
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_PROVE_TEXT: Rehearsals are held weekly at the band's headquarters. During preparation for concerts or events, rehearsals may become more frequent. Besides ensemble rehearsals, there are dedicated study sessions by section (woodwinds, brass, percussion).
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_DIREZIONE_TEXT: The artistic direction guides the band's musical path: choosing the repertoire, preparing concerts, coordinating with the music school. The conductor works closely with section leaders to ensure quality and cohesion.
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_CONCERTI_DESC: Performances in squares, theatres and public venues across the area
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_PROCESSIONI_DESC: Musical accompaniment for patron saint festivals and religious occasions
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_CERIMONIE_DESC: Participation in civil events, commemorations and celebrations
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_COLLAB_DESC: Projects with other musical groups, schools and associations
ABOUT_TODAY.JOIN_DESC: If you already play a wind or percussion instrument, you can become part of our group. Onboarding is gradual: you'll first take part in rehearsals and then, when ready, in performances.

ABOUT_SCHOOL.HEADER_DESC: The band's music school offers a complete training path: from reading music to instrumental technique, all the way to the experience of playing together. A welcoming environment to learn, grow and share a passion for music.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.INTRO_P1: The band's music school isn't just a place to learn to play: it's a learning journey that guides the student from the very first note all the way to joining the band's lineup. The method is based on a gradual approach, with attention to music theory, instrumental technique and, above all, ensemble practice.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.INTRO_P2: The teachers are experienced musicians, often active members of the band itself, who pass on not only technical skills but also a passion for music and a sense of belonging to a community.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVELS_DESC: Three progressive levels to guide each student along their musical journey.

ABOUT_HISTORY.HEADER_DESC: From Pedace's band tradition to the “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band: more than a century and a half of music, education and community life.
ABOUT_HISTORY.TOC_HINT: Select a chapter to open it.
ABOUT_HISTORY.TOC_4: From the 1960s to the new millennium
ABOUT_HISTORY.SUMMARY_ROOTS_VALUE: A band was active in Pedace by 1861
ABOUT_HISTORY.SUMMARY_MILESTONES_VALUE: Revival periods, music education and concert activity
ABOUT_HISTORY.SUMMARY_TODAY_VALUE: “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band since 2019
ABOUT_HISTORY.C1_P1: During the nineteenth century, town bands became one of Italy's main ways of bringing music to a broad audience. They performed marches, opera transcriptions and music for civic and religious ceremonies in public spaces.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C1_P2: Pedace's band tradition is documented as far back as 1861, when bandmaster Pasquale Martire was mentioned. The dating of several instruments preserved by the band is consistent with the second half of the nineteenth century.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C1_CAPTION: Pedace's Concerto Musicale, awarded a gold medal in 1924
ABOUT_HISTORY.C1_P3: Alongside performance, the band has always played an educational and social role: teaching discipline, listening, instrumental technique and cooperation while strengthening community identity.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C1_NOTE: Nineteenth-century records establish the age of this tradition; photographs and more detailed accounts become more plentiful during the twentieth century.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C2_CAPTION_1: A historic formation of the Pedace band
ABOUT_HISTORY.C2_P1: After the interruption caused by the First World War, the band resumed its work under bandmaster Adamo Nachira. During the 1920s it once again became an important place for education and social life.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C2_P2: In 1924 the Pedace band entered a provincial competition and won first prize and a gold medal. The dispute that followed and the rematch held the next year remain among the best-remembered episodes in its history.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C2_CAPTION_2: The continuing tradition of concerts in local churches
ABOUT_HISTORY.C2_P3: The competition story shows how closely the band was already tied to collective identity: music was not merely entertainment, but also representation, pride and civic participation.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C3_P1: The Second World War brought another interruption. Giuseppe Scalzo conducted the band in 1949; in the following years Archimede Michienzi took over and remained its conductor until 1964.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C3_CAPTION: The Città di Pedace band in an archival photograph
ABOUT_HISTORY.C3_P2: After a period of growth, the ensemble disbanded once more. Social change and emigration made continuity difficult, but its heritage of skills and relationships remained alive in the community.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_TITLE: From the 1960s to the new millennium
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_P1: The band re-formed in 1968 under Father Ciccio Calvelli. Bandmaster Salvatore Nicoletti took over in 1973, followed in 1979 by Franco Guglielmelli.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_CAPTION_1: A lesson at the band's music school
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_P2: The music school and concert programme expanded during the 1980s and 1990s. The repertoire grew and the band worked with musicians from neighbouring towns, becoming a bridge to advanced musical study for many young people.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_CAPTION_2: The full band performing in concert
ABOUT_HISTORY.C4_P3: In the new millennium, concerts, cultural exchanges and awards have confirmed the band's role as an important local cultural institution.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C5_P1: The municipality of Casali del Manco was created in 2017 through the merger of Casole Bruzio, Pedace, Serra Pedace, Spezzano Piccolo and Trenta. In 2019 the historic Pedace band adopted the name “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C5_CAPTION_MAIN: The “Città di Casali del Manco” Town Band today
ABOUT_HISTORY.C5_P2: Today the association brings together tradition, education and public performance. New generations, the music school and continuity in artistic leadership allow the band to evolve without losing touch with its roots.
ABOUT_HISTORY.C5_CAPTION_1: Musicians of different generations in the rehearsal room
